title: ResMerge: Residual-based Spectral Merging of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.02252v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model merging offers a training-free way to combine multiple post-trained expert models, but merging experts obtained through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging. Existing spectral merging methods often assume that leading singular directions contain the main task signal, while lower-energy residual components can be compressed, selected, or attenuated to reduce interference. We find that this assumption does not hold for RL task vectors: after decomposing each task vector into a leading spectral head and a residual component, both parts can independently recover substantial behavior knowledge, while exhibiting different merging properties. The head is highly concentrated and informative but more prone to sharp cross-expert conflicts, whereas the residual component is more dispersed and provides a more stable basis for aggregation. Based on this observation, we propose ResMerge, a residual-based spectral merging framework

translated_title: ResMerge：基于残差谱合并的大语言模型方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.02252v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：模型合并提供了一种无需训练的方式来组合多个后训练专家模型，但合并通过强化学习（RL）获得的专家模型仍然具有挑战性。现有的谱合并方法通常假设主导奇异方向包含主要任务信号，而低能量残差成分可以被压缩、选择或衰减以减少干扰。我们发现这一假设不适用于RL任务向量：在将每个任务向量分解为前导谱头部和残差成分后，两者都能独立恢复大量行为知识，同时表现出不同的合并特性。头部高度集中且信息丰富，但更容易引发尖锐的跨专家冲突，而残差成分更分散，为聚合提供了更稳定的基础。基于这一观察，我们提出了ResMerge，一种基于残差的谱合并框架。
tldr: 本文发现强化学习任务向量的谱头部和残差成分具有不同合并特性，提出ResMerge框架，利用残差成分的稳定性实现更有效的模型合并。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that the spectral head and residual component of RL task vectors exhibit different merging properties, and proposes ResMerge, a residual-based spectral merging framework that leverages the stability of residual components for more effective model merging.
